overall.verdict: The mobile dark variant demonstrates strong execution of the visceral value concept and maintains excellent consistency across screens. The premium dark aesthetic is largely successful though some text elements lack sufficient contrast and hierarchy. The responsive design effectively adapts to mobile constraints while preserving the core visual language.
priority_fixes: Increase text contrast and size for better readability
Refine the home screen hierarchy and remove redundant elements
Improve visual feedback for interactive elements
Enhance the swap screen user experience and clarity
